text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Out of the way! Clear the road!

During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Jungle Pocket ran with fierce, untamed power.

"A dangerous powerhouse you shouldn't mess with."
That impression only grew stronger...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, by the way, Trainer,
there's something I want to borrow.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You don't happen to have nunchucks on ya, do you?
Nunchucks.
choice_data_list: Nunchucks!? I don't have any, what are you talking about!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's fine.
If you don't have it, nothing can be done.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should go with a bare-knuckle brawl style.

Wondering what she plans to do,
I grow worried and decide to follow her...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come on. It couldn't be helped that you lost.
There's no reason to cry over it, is there?

Did Jungle Pocket beat them in a fight?
As I watched the situation unfold...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks"... I wanted to win it no matter what.
To avenge my mother. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Following a 4th-place finish in the Oka Sho, 2nd place again this time...
If I keep going without winning a single Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't beat yourself up over it. In races,
if even one thing goes wrong, there are times you just can't win.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't get down, Messiah. Smile.
I... just want to see you smiling, you know?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Pocket-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There ain't much I can do for you.
The most I can manage is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
About this much.
Oryaaa!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Pocket-senpai, what's that...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Can't you tell by looking? It's kung fu, kung fu.
I practiced it yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Thought I'd show you this.
Ho-ooo, whaa-chaa!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tch, it just doesn't feel complete
without nunchucks...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: P-Pocket-senpai, I appreciate the thought, but... why kung fu...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just thought doing a silly impression
might make you laugh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and also, this...
I'm giving it to you, so drink up."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's the limited-time Muscat Hachimi.
Down it in one gulp. It'll blow your mind, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much.
Well then...
(Slurp...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: How is it, tasty?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, it really touched my heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Not just the taste... but Pocket-senpai's kindness too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Some people call her a violent Umamusume.
But they're definitely misunderstanding her.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Pocket-senpai is... a good person.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows?
But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to see you've cheered up.
It seems... I was worrying over nothing.

Jungle Pocket would never hurt someone
without a reason.
On the contrary...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... so bored. I'm so boooored~
You know theme park rides...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Waiting in line is such a total buzzkill, right?
Majorly deflating...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, guess there's no helping it.
Then I'll just go ahead and kill that free time for ya.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wanna shoot the breeze? Play Shiritori? Or maybe get sweaty in some video games?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Umm, well then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "I'll eat! Soft and creamy, please!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
An errand boy, seriously?!
Well, whatever. Fine, I got it.

She was kind even to the downer gyaru Umamusume,
Tosen Jordan, and—

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah, it's Jungle Pocket!
Pokke-samaー!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pipe down.
It's really not that big of a deal.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll do handshakes and autographs, so just
line up nicely. Don't go shoving and getting hurt, got it?

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list: You're so popular. And you're good at handling it, too.
You're quite popular, huh? And you're so good at handling it, too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's not it!
These guys have got it all wrong!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even when I treat her roughly, she actually likes it.
Why? Man, I just don't get it at all...
Jungle Pocket, always wild yet casually kind, was hugely popular with the female fans.

While rampaging with youthful vigor, contrary to her intentions,
she continued to receive squeals of adoration.
